_notes: Verified positions pulled from published mapping studies and SGN locus pages (SL2.50 genome build). Where only a marker interval size is known (not exact bp), a window is estimated around the cited anchor position and flagged 'approximate_window'. Ph-3 has no single confirmed Solyc gene ID in public literature as of this seed -- it is left as chromosome-level only, honestly flagged, rather than guessed.
